the author's own proof environment immediately following the proposition: reduce to affine S; make the torsion degree uniform: the pointwise annihilator function is locally constant with finitely many values (trivializing finite etale cover), giving an open and closed decomposition of X; replace S by the open and closed image of f so n becomes invertible on S; descend to Noetherian base over Z[1/n] by finite presentation descent of f, improvement of f_i, and descent of F through the colimit description of locally constant sheaves with the n-torsion replacement Ker(n); conclude with constructibility from theorem-constructible-shriek, isomorphic specialization maps, and the locally constant characterization (source lines 5014-5071)
